app.name: Attar Sort
shop.label: {name} Spice Shop
name.body.first: This shop is yours now, and I'll teach you the trade. What should the sign say?
name.body.rename: The new name will show on the sign right away.
name.suggestions: Baraka, Khair, Hana, Amana, Abu El Dahab, El Sharq
name.note: You can rename any time by tapping the sign or from Settings.
name.err.short: Enter at least 2 characters, or pick a suggestion
name.err.long: That's too long, keep it to 18 characters or fewer
name.err.chars: Use letters, numbers, and spaces only
ui.daily.title: Today's challenge
ui.counterEmpty: Decorate your shop with coins from the shop button
order.title: Rush order
toast.closed: This jar is done and sealed
toast.mismatch: Pour onto the same spice or into an empty jar
toast.hint: Pour from the lifted jar into the glowing one
toast.hintUnsolvable: No solution from here. Undo a few moves or add a jar
toast.hintNotFound: Can't find a hint right now, try undoing a move
hassan.nameAsk: Welcome! Before we open, name the shop.
hassan.welcomeSkipped: Fine, you can name it later from the sign.
hassan.tut1: The lifted jar is your first move: tap it, then tap the glowing jar. Each spice goes on its own kind or into an empty jar.
hassan.unlock2: Made a mistake? Undo takes you back a step, and Restart starts over.
hassan.unlock3: You now have hints and an extra jar, and your coins collect up top.
hassan.unlock4: You have enough coins to decorate! Tap the shop button up top.
hassan.unlock5: From today there's a daily reward and a daily challenge, from the calendar button.
hassan.hidden12: Those marks are hidden spices. They show once what's above is gone. Focus!
hassan.world1: We moved to the storeroom! Now we work with sacks.
hassan.world2: Welcome to the brass corner, the finest part of the shop.
hassan.world0again: Back to the jars, but the work is tougher now.
hassan.order: Heads up, a customer wants {a} and {b} before any other spice.
hassan.orderDone: The customer is happy! We earned {coins} coins.
hassan.hard: This one's tough, and coins are doubled. Think before you pour.
hassan.rest: Catch your breath, this one's light.
hassan.normal.2: Sort this shelf and the tea's on me.
hassan.normal.3: Easy now, a spice shop needs patience.
hassan.normal.4: Every spice in its place, that's the trade.
hassan.win.2: Now I can open early tomorrow.
hassan.invalid: No no, each spice on its own kind.
hassan.stuck: Stuck? Undo a step, no worries.
hassan.cat: That's Basbousa, the shop cat. Don't wake her.
hassan.dailyReward: Today's reward is yours, see you tomorrow.
hassan.day7: Day seven! A tea tray for {shop}, my gift.
hassan.dailyStart: Today's challenge! Everyone gets the same puzzle, show them your skill.
hassan.streakFirst: Day one of your streak, come back tomorrow.
hassan.streakMore: A {days} streak! You're a regular now.
hassan.starterThanks: Thanks, master! Your hints and coins are ready.
hassan.theme.ramadan: Ramadan Kareem! The lanterns are up.
hassan.theme.eid: Happy Eid, the shop is decorated.
hassan.theme.spring: Happy Sham El-Nessim! We brought colored eggs.

reminder.ask.title: Daily reminder?
reminder.ask.body: Uncle Hassan sends at most one reminder a day so your streak survives. Turn it off any time in Settings.
reminder.streak: Uncle Hassan: your streak is {days}, keep it going! Today's challenge is waiting.
reminder.reward: Uncle Hassan: today's reward is waiting at {shop}.
reminder.generic: Uncle Hassan: customers are asking for you.
ui.helpBody: Select a jar, then an empty jar or one with the same spice on top. Fill each jar with one spice.
ui.featureBody: This feature is being prepared. You can keep playing with the free helpers.
